source.name: Netcomsn: Basket sénégalais — KEBIMO prolonge son partenariat avec l'ASC Ville de Dakar pour la WBLA et la BAL 2025-2026
source.quote: pour un soutien financier de 20 millions FCFA lors de la saison 2025-2026
source.note: Support amount reported in FCFA (20m for 2025-26, covering WBLA and BAL; 40m in 2024 per the same article). The deal schema takes GBP/EUR/USD only, so value stays null. Le Journal de Dakar (13 Apr 2026) additionally reports FCFA 10m for 2026 plus FCFA 10m for the BAL campaign, but that site blocks scripts (403).

note: KEBIMO's reported support for ASC Ville de Dakar: FCFA 20m for the 2025-26 season (WBLA and BAL), partnership officialized 25 Nov 2025; FCFA 40m in 2024 (Netcomsn); FCFA 10m for 2026 plus FCFA 10m for the BAL campaign (Le Journal de Dakar, 13 Apr 2026).
